# MediaPipe Hands

The files in this directory are vendored from `@mediapipe/hands` version
`0.4.1675469240`, published by Google under the Apache License 2.0.

- Source package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/hands
- License: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

They are kept local so hand tracking does not require a third-party CDN at
runtime. The rest of this repository remains covered by its root license.

The controller's calibrated absolute-target mapping was informed by the
gesture-control example published at https://www.yjln.com/643.html. No complete
source block from that page is vendored here.
